d: Great room in the Palazzo del Regente, with spacious veronas open in perspective, from which I glimpsed magnificent part of the city.
Lord Howe, Kilkardy and other courtiers come several times; they look from the verons, then they group together, talking softly among themselves.
The Regent with Séguito, and sayings.
Hamilton, and sayings.
Oscar, and sayings.

The habiture of the magician: on the right a path and a boiler on a tripod some tizzi burn around you; then the entrance to another room; on the opposite side a secret exit on the top of a small ladder; in the bottom the door and a window, through which I glimpsed the port of Edinburgh. Meg at the boiler, Scotus and People beyond the door, then the Regent.
A Servant of Amelia, and sayings.
Amelia, and sayings.
Oscar, Howe, Kilkardy, and other courtiers disguised as people, and sayings.
Hamilton, and sayings.
People, and sayings.

A wild place in the vicinity of Edinburgh: at the bottom of a valley, formed by bare rocks, you can see the cemetery of the condemned to the extreme torture: the river snakes a little far: the sky is covered with thick clouds, which moved by the wind, now show, now hide the moon. From a suburb of the city sounds midnight. It is Amelia advance, then the Regent.
Hamilton, and sayings.
Howe, Kilkardy, Conjure up and say.
A room in Hamilton's palace, with closed doors, and a window at the bottom. Amelia fainted over a sofa, then Hamilton.
A Servant and sayings.
Secret room, or weapons room in a tower in Hamilton's palace.
Howe, Kilkardy, Conjure up and say.

A room of the apartments destined for the party, which is given in the Palazzo del Regente: at the bottom large stairs that put to the upper galleries, where are the orchestras. Everywhere shine vague numbers doubles. Ladies and Knights, other masked, others in rich court clothing, then a person shaped by Negromante; finally a Lady in white dominoes.
A man covered in black dominoes with a blue band and quilted gold moves slowly, then sits in dark thoughts, and takes off the mask; it is the Regent.
Amelia in white dominoes as before, and said.
The above, Hamilton, Howe, Kilkardy, Conjured, all in black dominoes with white ribbon on the right arm, then Oscar, Dame, and Knights.
